title: Moss Tidies the Bird Table
checkpoint: Phase 1 (Introduction) — a wordless story for sharing and talking through together; there are no sounds to decode yet.
note_for_grown_ups: A quiet story about tidying up after someone else's mess, without being asked — talk about times your child has done something kind like this too.

pages.talk_prompt: The bird table looks very messy — what do you think happened here?
pages.illustration: A wooden bird table scattered with loose seeds and broken shells, a bird flying off in the background.

pages.talk_prompt: Moss has arrived and is looking at the mess — what do you think he is planning to do?
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog standing at the base of the bird table, looking up at the scattered seeds on the ground around him.

pages.talk_prompt: Moss is gathering up the scattered seeds — where do you think he is putting them?
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog gathering scattered seeds and shells into a small neat pile on the grass.

pages.talk_prompt: Moss is using a twig to help tidy up — what is he doing with it?
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog sweeping loose shells together using a long thin twig like a little broom.

pages.talk_prompt: Look how tidy the area is now — what has changed?
pages.illustration: The ground beneath the bird table now neat and clear, with one tidy pile of seeds at the base.

pages.talk_prompt: A new visitor has come to the tidy bird table — how do you think Moss feels watching?
pages.illustration: Nell the bee landing to feed from the tidy bird table while Moss the hedgehog watches contentedly from below.
